race.title: David Lucas Best Prices Welsh Sport Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: NORTHWEST PASSAGE was most impressive when winning at Southwell last week and can defy a penalty at the chief expense of Jollie Dame , who took a step forward herself when making a successful handicap debut at Worcester. Best Trump can complete the 1-2-3. NORTHWEST PASSAGE JOLLIE DAME BEST TRUMP (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Northwest Passage (11/4), Jollie Dame (10/3), Mount Washington (6/1), Best Trump (10/1), Red N Yellow (10/1), Zambezi Fix (10/1), Bouquet De Paris (12/1), Mistral St Georges (14/1), Activist (16/1), In Limbo (16/1), Both Of Us (25/1), Golden Wings (33/1)
